inputs.text: [confidently] Good evening. Tonight, one simple question: if you could save humanity with a single trade, would you do it?
[dryly] That depends. Are you saving humanity, or opening a position against it?
[slightly offended] I can care about people and recognize an attractive market opportunity.
[matter-of-factly] And I closed the position at a substantial profit.
[patiently] Here is the choice. Everyone receives enough, but no one can possess everything.
Food, shelter, medicine, safety, and a little peace.
[horrified] Peace? Do you understand what that would do to quarterly growth?
[amused] Perhaps humanity could survive one disappointing quarter.
[reluctantly] Fine. Save humanity. But I want it recorded that I considered the tax implications.
